Elena: Morning team — quick weekly sync. Key highlights:
- Hosted API p95 latency: 310ms (down 12ms from last week)
- Cost per 1M tokens reduced ~8% after batching tweaks
- Dedicated pilot signed with AtlasHealth (starts Apr 1)
Priorities this week: 1) finish dedicated autoscaling gating (Samir + infra), 2) finalize Private onboarding checklist (Marcos + Legal), 3) put Q2 hiring plan for SRE into motion (Anya+Luca).

Marcos: Congrats on AtlasHealth! I'll coordinate legal for the SOC2 addendum. Shared onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/obs/onboarding (link)

Samir: Autoscale patch in staging, seeing flapping at high burst rates. Adding circuit-breaker and blue-green steps. Request: hold off on canary traffic until EOD Wednesday.

Anya: I'll greenlight the hiring req for two SREs and one infra eng. Will also spin up on-call rota adjustments for the Dedicated pilot window.

Luca: Financials look good for the pilot. We have margin buffer for first 90 days. Please attach expected ramp metrics (throughput, cost) by Thursday.

ops-bot: Deploy 2026-03-19T02:14:22Z to staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

Elena: Thanks all. FYI — metrics we'll track daily this week: latency p50/p95, per-token unit cost, Dedicated pool utilization, and error rate by model. Send any blockers in #release-war-room. :rocket:

Marcos: Noted. Also prepping customer comms for Dedicated launch — draft by Friday for review.

Samir: I'll post the canary checklist and rollback plan in eng-releases. Also re: flapping, plan to throttle burst concurrency rather than drop requests.

Anya: Onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-onboard (draft). Please comment.

Elena: One quick ask — keep exec updates to one-line status if you're pinging me directly. If you need decisions, put in doc with options. Appreciate the focus :heart:

Luca: Will add the financial ramp table by Thu EOD.

Elena: Great. End of thread.
